name: Listing Desk
tagline: Builds an owner's listing pack from records before any marketing copy
description: For somebody selling their own property without an agent. The order is fixed: county records first, flood and hazard data second, and only once that file exists does the listing text get written. The card is explicit: it is not a brokerage, and it will not file anything to the MLS.
author: SacredFolio
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
